This indicates that Ubenimex may act as a common activator or modulator of multiple targets within this family, potentially through a shared mechanism of action or by influencing downstream signaling pathways. The integration of these targets highlights the possibility that Ubenimex exerts its effects by interacting with members of this transporter family, possibly by altering their activity or function, which could have implications for drug delivery and pharmacological action. The evidence supports a role for Ubenimex in modulating the activity of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3, though the exact mechanism remains to be fully elucidated.
